title: The flats, Palm Sunday
logline: The flats on a Sunday in April with a family far out on them in good clothes, small, the pup and the man from behind nearer. The page doesn't say the day; the clothes do.

panels.composition: Wide mudflats with a family in good clothes far out, small, and nearer a man in plaid from behind with an old three-legged dog, April light.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, wide tidal mudflats with a family in good clothes far out and small, and nearer a man in plaid flannel seen from behind with an old three-legged dog, April light, no words
